MRK.P.8.14-21.text: The Leaven of the Pharisees and of Herod

MRK.P.9.30-32.text: The Second Prediction of the Passion

MRK.1.1-3.text: Isaiah wrote that God would send a messenger first

MRK.1.4-6.text: John preaches and baptizes people in the Jordan River

MRK.1.7-8.text: John says the one coming will baptize with the Holy Spirit

MRK.1.9-11.text: John baptizes Jesus, and God speaks from heaven

MRK.1.12-13.text: The Spirit sends Jesus into the wilderness to be tempted

MRK.1.14-15.text: Jesus preaches in Galilee that God’s kingdom is near

MRK.1.16-18.text: Jesus calls Simon and Andrew to follow him

MRK.1.19-20.text: Jesus calls James and John, sons of Zebedee

MRK.1.21-22.text: Jesus teaches in the synagogue in Capernaum with authority

MRK.1.23-26.text: Jesus commands an unclean spirit to leave a man

MRK.1.27-28.text: The people are amazed, and news about Jesus spreads

MRK.1.29-31.text: Jesus heals Simon’s mother-in-law of a fever

MRK.1.32-34.text: Jesus heals many sick people and drives out demons

MRK.1.35-37.text: Simon and others find Jesus praying alone

MRK.1.38-39.text: Jesus goes through Galilee to preach and drive out demons

MRK.1.40-42.text: Jesus touches a man with leprosy and makes him clean

MRK.1.43-44.text: Jesus tells the healed man to show himself to the priest

MRK.1.45-45.text: The man spreads the news, and crowds come to Jesus

MRK.2.1-2.text: Crowds gather at the house where Jesus is teaching

MRK.2.3-4.text: Four men lower a paralyzed man through the roof to Jesus

MRK.2.5-7.text: Jesus forgives the man’s sins, and scribes object

MRK.2.8-9.text: Jesus knows what the scribes think and asks a question

MRK.2.10-12.text: Jesus heals the paralyzed man, and people praise God

MRK.2.13-14.text: Jesus calls Levi, a tax collector, to follow him

MRK.2.15-16.text: Jesus eats with sinners, and scribes ask why

MRK.2.17-17.text: Jesus says he came to call sinners, not the righteous

MRK.2.18-19.text: Jesus explains why his disciples do not fast

MRK.2.20-20.text: Jesus says his disciples will fast when he is gone

MRK.2.21-21.text: Jesus says no one sews new cloth on an old garment

MRK.2.22-22.text: Jesus says new wine needs new wineskins

MRK.2.23-24.text: Pharisees object when disciples pick grain on the Sabbath

MRK.2.25-26.text: Jesus reminds the Pharisees how David ate the holy bread

MRK.2.27-28.text: Jesus says the Son of Man is Lord of the Sabbath

MRK.3.1-2.text: People watch Jesus to see if he heals on the Sabbath

MRK.3.3-4.text: Jesus asks if it is right to do good on the Sabbath

MRK.3.5-6.text: Jesus heals a man’s hand; Pharisees plot to kill Jesus

MRK.3.7-8.text: Large crowds from many places come to Jesus

MRK.3.9-10.text: Jesus asks for a boat because the crowd presses on him

MRK.3.11-12.text: Unclean spirits call Jesus the Son of God

MRK.3.13-16.text: Jesus chooses twelve men to be apostles

MRK.3.17-19.text: The rest of the twelve apostles are named

MRK.3.20-22.text: Some say Jesus is out of his mind or has a demon

MRK.3.23-25.text: Jesus says a divided kingdom or house cannot stand

MRK.3.26-27.text: Jesus says Satan cannot stand if he is divided

MRK.3.31-32.text: Jesus’ mother and brothers wait outside for him

MRK.3.33-35.text: Jesus says those who do God’s will are his family

MRK.4.1-2.text: Jesus teaches the crowd in parables from a boat

MRK.4.3-5.text: A farmer’s seed falls on the path and on rocky ground

MRK.4.6-7.text: Some seed withers in the sun or is choked by thorns

MRK.4.8-9.text: Seed on good soil gives a crop; Jesus says to listen

MRK.4.13-15.text: Jesus explains the seed along the path

MRK.4.16-17.text: Jesus explains the seed on rocky ground

MRK.4.18-20.text: Jesus explains the seed among thorns and on good soil

MRK.4.21-23.text: Jesus says hidden things will be made known

MRK.4.24-25.text: Jesus warns the crowd to listen carefully

MRK.4.30-32.text: Jesus says God’s kingdom is like a mustard seed

MRK.4.33-34.text: Jesus uses parables and explains all to the disciples

MRK.4.35-37.text: A violent storm hits the disciples’ boat on the sea

MRK.4.38-39.text: Jesus wakes and calms the wind and the sea

MRK.4.40-41.text: The disciples are afraid and ask who Jesus is

MRK.5.1-2.text: Jesus arrives and meets a man with an unclean spirit

MRK.5.3-4.text: No one can restrain the man with the unclean spirit

MRK.5.5-6.text: The man runs to Jesus and kneels before him

MRK.5.7-8.text: The man shouts and begs Jesus not to torture him

MRK.5.9-10.text: The spirit says its name is Legion

MRK.5.11-13.text: Jesus lets the demons enter pigs, and the pigs drown

MRK.5.14-15.text: The people see the healed man and are afraid

MRK.5.16-17.text: The people beg Jesus to leave the region

MRK.5.18-20.text: Jesus sends the healed man to tell what the Lord did

MRK.5.21-24.text: Jairus begs Jesus to heal his dying daughter

MRK.5.25-27.text: A woman who had bled for twelve years touches Jesus’ cloak

MRK.5.28-29.text: The woman is healed as soon as she touches Jesus

MRK.5.30-32.text: Jesus feels power leave Him and asks who touched Him

MRK.5.33-34.text: The woman tells Jesus the truth and is sent in peace

MRK.5.35-35.text: Messengers tell Jairus that his daughter is dead

MRK.5.36-38.text: Jesus tells Jairus not to be afraid, only to believe

MRK.5.39-40.text: Jesus puts the mourners out and goes in to the child

MRK.5.41-43.text: Jesus raises the girl, and everyone is astounded

MRK.6.1-3.text: The people in Jesus’ hometown are offended by Him

MRK.6.4-6.text: Jesus can do few miracles because of unbelief

MRK.6.7-9.text: Jesus sends out the Twelve with authority over spirits

MRK.6.10-11.text: Jesus tells the Twelve how to act when welcomed or refused

MRK.6.12-13.text: The Twelve preach, drive out demons and heal the sick

MRK.6.14-15.text: Herod hears that people think Jesus is John or Elijah

MRK.6.16-17.text: Herod says John, whom he beheaded, has risen

MRK.6.18-20.text: John condemns Herod’s marriage; Herodias wants John dead

MRK.6.21-22.text: Herod promises the dancing girl whatever she asks

MRK.6.23-25.text: The girl asks for John’s head on a platter

MRK.6.26-29.text: Herod has John beheaded, and John’s disciples bury him

MRK.6.30-32.text: The apostles report to Jesus and go away to rest

MRK.6.33-34.text: Jesus has compassion on the crowd and teaches the people

MRK.6.35-36.text: The disciples ask Jesus to send the crowd away to eat

MRK.6.37-38.text: Jesus tells the disciples to give the crowd food

MRK.6.39-41.text: Jesus blesses five loaves and two fish and shares the food

MRK.6.42-44.text: Five thousand men eat and twelve baskets are left

MRK.6.45-47.text: Jesus sends the disciples ahead and goes up to pray

MRK.6.48-50.text: Jesus walks on the sea and tells the disciples not to fear

MRK.6.51-52.text: Jesus calms the wind, and the disciples are astounded

MRK.6.53-55.text: The people of Gennesaret bring the sick to Jesus

MRK.6.56-56.text: Sick people touch Jesus’ cloak and are healed

MRK.7.1-1.text: Pharisees and scribes from Jerusalem gather around Jesus

MRK.7.2-4.text: Pharisees see that disciples eat with unwashed hands

MRK.7.5-5.text: Pharisees ask Jesus why disciples eat with unclean hands

MRK.7.6-7.text: Jesus calls the Pharisees hypocrites, as Isaiah wrote

MRK.7.8-10.text: Jesus says the Pharisees ignore God’s command for tradition

MRK.7.11-13.text: Jesus says the Pharisees’ Corban rule cancels God’s word

MRK.7.14-16.text: Jesus teaches the crowd what makes a person unclean

MRK.7.17-19.text: Jesus tells disciples that food cannot make people unclean

MRK.7.20-23.text: Jesus says evil from the heart makes a person unclean

MRK.7.24-26.text: A Greek woman asks Jesus to free her daughter from a demon

MRK.7.27-28.text: Jesus and the woman talk about children’s bread and dogs

MRK.7.29-30.text: Jesus frees the woman’s daughter from the demon

MRK.7.31-32.text: People bring a deaf man to Jesus in the Decapolis

MRK.7.33-35.text: Jesus heals the deaf man so he can hear and speak

MRK.7.36-37.text: Jesus orders silence, but the people spread the news

MRK.8.1-4.text: Jesus feels sorry for the hungry crowd

MRK.8.5-6.text: Jesus gives thanks for seven loaves and breaks the bread

MRK.8.7-10.text: The four thousand eat and seven baskets are left over

MRK.8.14-15.text: Jesus warns disciples to beware of Pharisees and Herod

MRK.8.16-17.text: Jesus asks why the disciples argue about having no bread

MRK.8.18-19.text: Jesus reminds disciples how he fed five thousand

MRK.8.20-21.text: Jesus reminds disciples how he fed four thousand

MRK.8.22-23.text: People bring a blind man to Jesus at Bethsaida

MRK.8.24-26.text: Jesus touches the blind man again and he sees clearly

MRK.8.27-28.text: Jesus asks the disciples who people say he is

MRK.8.29-30.text: Peter says Jesus is the Christ; Jesus orders silence

MRK.8.31-32.text: Jesus teaches that he must suffer, and Peter rebukes him

MRK.8.33-33.text: Jesus rebukes Peter for thinking like men

MRK.8.34-34.text: Jesus tells the crowd and disciples to take up the cross

MRK.8.35-37.text: Jesus says whoever loses life for him will save it

MRK.8.38-38.text: Jesus warns people not to be ashamed of him

MRK.9.1-3.text: Jesus takes three disciples up a mountain and is changed

MRK.9.4-6.text: Elijah and Moses appear; Peter offers to build shelters

MRK.9.7-8.text: God speaks from a cloud: listen to his Son

MRK.9.9-10.text: Jesus tells the disciples to tell no one yet

MRK.9.11-13.text: Jesus explains to the disciples that Elijah has come

MRK.9.14-16.text: Jesus finds a crowd arguing with the disciples

MRK.9.17-19.text: A father says the disciples could not drive out a spirit

MRK.9.20-22.text: The spirit throws the boy down; his father asks for help

MRK.9.23-25.text: Jesus tells the father to believe, then frees the boy

MRK.9.26-27.text: Jesus lifts the boy up after the spirit comes out

MRK.9.28-29.text: Jesus says this kind of spirit needs prayer

MRK.9.30-32.text: The Second Prediction of the Passion

MRK.9.33-35.text: Jesus teaches the Twelve that the first must serve all

MRK.9.36-37.text: Jesus teaches the disciples to welcome little children

MRK.9.38-39.text: Jesus tells John not to stop a man who drives out demons

MRK.9.40-41.text: Jesus says those who help his followers will be rewarded

MRK.9.42-44.text: Jesus warns against causing believers to stumble and sin

MRK.9.45-46.text: Jesus says to cut off a foot that causes sin

MRK.9.47-48.text: Jesus says to remove an eye that causes sin

MRK.10.1-4.text: Pharisees test Jesus by asking about divorce

MRK.10.5-6.text: Jesus says Moses wrote the law because of hard hearts

MRK.10.7-9.text: Jesus says God joins husband and wife as one

MRK.10.10-12.text: Jesus teaches the disciples about divorce and adultery

MRK.10.13-14.text: Jesus tells the disciples to let children come to him

MRK.10.15-16.text: Jesus says to receive God’s kingdom like a child

MRK.10.17-19.text: A man asks Jesus how to inherit eternal life

MRK.10.20-22.text: Jesus tells the rich man to sell all and follow him

MRK.10.23-25.text: Jesus says it is hard for rich people to enter the kingdom

MRK.10.26-28.text: Jesus says all things are possible with God

MRK.10.29-31.text: Jesus promises rewards to those who leave all for him

MRK.10.32-34.text: The Third Prediction of the Passion

MRK.10.35-37.text: James and John ask Jesus for the seats of honor

MRK.10.38-40.text: Jesus asks James and John about drinking his cup

MRK.10.41-42.text: The ten are angry with James and John

MRK.10.43-45.text: Jesus says the greatest must serve, as the Son of Man did

MRK.10.46-48.text: Blind Bartimaeus calls out to Jesus for mercy

MRK.10.49-50.text: Jesus calls Bartimaeus, and he jumps up and comes

MRK.10.51-52.text: Bartimaeus asks to see again and follows Jesus

MRK.11.1-3.text: Jesus sends two disciples to bring a colt

MRK.11.4-6.text: The two disciples find the colt as Jesus said

MRK.11.7-10.text: The crowd praises Jesus as he rides the colt

MRK.11.11-11.text: Jesus looks around the temple and goes to Bethany

MRK.11.12-12.text: Jesus is hungry after leaving Bethany

MRK.11.13-14.text: Jesus finds no fruit on a fig tree and curses it

MRK.11.15-16.text: Jesus drives out buyers and sellers from the temple

MRK.11.17-19.text: Jesus says the temple should be a house of prayer

MRK.11.20-21.text: Peter sees that the fig tree has withered

MRK.11.22-23.text: Jesus tells the disciples to have faith in God

MRK.11.24-25.text: Jesus teaches the disciples about prayer and forgiving

MRK.11.27-28.text: Priests, scribes and elders ask about Jesus’ authority

MRK.11.29-30.text: Jesus asks the leaders about John’s baptism

MRK.11.31-33.text: The leaders fear the people and do not answer Jesus

MRK.12.1-3.text: Jesus tells of a man whose tenants beat his servant

MRK.12.4-5.text: The tenants beat and kill more servants

MRK.12.6-7.text: The tenants plan to kill the owner’s son

MRK.12.8-9.text: The tenants kill the son and lose the vineyard

MRK.12.10-12.text: Jesus quotes Scripture about the rejected stone

MRK.12.13-15.text: Pharisees and Herodians try to trap Jesus

MRK.12.16-17.text: Jesus says to give Caesar’s things to Caesar

MRK.12.18-19.text: Sadducees ask Jesus about a widow and Moses’ law

MRK.12.20-23.text: Sadducees ask about a woman married to seven brothers

MRK.12.24-25.text: Jesus says the risen dead will be like angels

MRK.12.26-27.text: Jesus says God is the God of the living

MRK.12.28-31.text: Jesus names the two greatest commandments

MRK.12.32-34.text: Jesus tells the scribe he is near the kingdom of God

MRK.12.41-42.text: Jesus watches a poor widow give two small coins

MRK.12.43-44.text: Jesus says the widow gave more than all the others

MRK.13.1-2.text: Jesus says the temple buildings will be thrown down

MRK.13.3-4.text: Four disciples ask Jesus when these things will happen

MRK.13.5-6.text: Jesus warns the disciples not to be deceived

MRK.13.7-8.text: Jesus says wars and earthquakes are only the beginning

MRK.13.9-10.text: Disciples will be witnesses; the gospel goes to all nations

MRK.13.11-13.text: The Holy Spirit will speak for believers when arrested

MRK.13.14-16.text: Jesus tells people in Judea to flee to the mountains

MRK.13.17-20.text: Jesus says God will shorten the days of great trouble

MRK.13.21-23.text: Jesus warns believers not to trust false Christs

MRK.13.24-27.text: The Return of the Son of Man

MRK.13.28-29.text: Jesus uses the fig tree to show his coming is near

MRK.13.30-31.text: Jesus says his words will never pass away

MRK.13.32-32.text: Only the Father knows the day and hour

MRK.13.33-34.text: Jesus tells the disciples to be on guard and stay alert

MRK.13.35-37.text: Jesus tells everyone to keep watch for the master’s return

MRK.14.3-5.text: A woman pours perfume on Jesus and some are angry

MRK.14.6-9.text: Jesus defends the woman and praises what she did

MRK.14.12-14.text: Jesus sends two disciples to prepare the Passover

MRK.14.15-16.text: The disciples find the room and prepare the Passover

MRK.14.17-19.text: Jesus says one of the Twelve will betray him

MRK.14.20-21.text: Jesus says the betrayer is one eating with him

MRK.14.22-25.text: Jesus gives the disciples bread and the cup

MRK.14.26-26.text: Jesus and the disciples sing and go to the Mount of Olives

MRK.14.27-27.text: Jesus says all the disciples will fall away

MRK.14.28-29.text: Peter says he will never fall away

MRK.14.30-31.text: Jesus tells Peter he will deny him three times

MRK.14.32-34.text: Jesus goes to Gethsemane and is deeply troubled

MRK.14.35-36.text: Jesus prays that God will take the cup from him

MRK.14.37-39.text: Jesus finds Peter asleep and tells him to watch and pray

MRK.14.40-42.text: Jesus says the hour has come and his betrayer is near

MRK.14.43-46.text: Judas betrays Jesus with a kiss and men arrest him

MRK.14.47-50.text: Jesus questions the crowd, and the disciples run away

MRK.14.51-52.text: A young man runs away without his clothes

MRK.14.53-54.text: Jesus is taken to the high priest; Peter follows

MRK.14.55-56.text: Leaders look for proof against Jesus but find none

MRK.14.57-59.text: Some men lie about what Jesus said of the temple

MRK.14.60-62.text: Jesus tells the high priest that he is the Christ

MRK.14.63-65.text: The council condemns Jesus, and men beat him

MRK.14.66-68.text: A servant girl accuses Peter, and Peter denies Jesus

MRK.14.69-70.text: Peter again says he is not one of Jesus’ followers

MRK.14.71-72.text: Peter denies Jesus a third time and weeps

MRK.15.1-3.text: Jewish leaders hand Jesus over to Pilate

MRK.15.4-5.text: Jesus gives Pilate no answer, and Pilate is amazed

MRK.15.6-8.text: The crowd asks Pilate to free a prisoner

MRK.15.9-11.text: Chief priests urge the crowd to ask for Barabbas

MRK.15.12-13.text: The crowd shouts that Pilate must crucify Jesus

MRK.15.14-15.text: Pilate frees Barabbas and hands Jesus over to be crucified

MRK.15.16-18.text: Soldiers dress Jesus as a king and mock him

MRK.15.19-20.text: Soldiers beat Jesus and lead him out to be crucified

MRK.15.21-21.text: Soldiers force Simon of Cyrene to carry Jesus’ cross

MRK.15.25-28.text: Jesus is crucified between two robbers

MRK.15.29-30.text: People passing by insult Jesus on the cross

MRK.15.31-32.text: Leaders and the two robbers mock Jesus

MRK.15.33-35.text: Darkness comes, and Jesus cries out to God

MRK.15.36-38.text: Jesus dies, and the temple curtain tears in two

MRK.15.39-41.text: A centurion says Jesus is the Son of God

MRK.15.42-44.text: Joseph of Arimathea asks Pilate for Jesus’ body

MRK.15.45-47.text: Joseph buries Jesus in a tomb cut in the rock

MRK.16.1-2.text: Three women go to Jesus’ tomb with spices

MRK.16.3-4.text: The women find that the large stone is rolled away

MRK.16.5-7.text: A young man tells the women that Jesus has risen

MRK.16.8-8.text: The women flee from the tomb and tell no one

MRK.16.14-16.text: Jesus rebukes the Eleven and sends them to preach

MRK.16.17-18.text: Jesus says signs will follow those who believe
